name: Signeasy
summary: E-signature and contract management for SMBs — unlimited signing and sending, templates, audit trails and integrations, priced per seat.
best_for: small teams that want straightforward unlimited sending and signing per seat, with contract management one tier up
skip_if: you only sign occasional documents, or you are a solo sender at volume — Personal is single-seat and sending-limited
honest_knock: The $10 Personal plan is annual-billed and single-seat — and note that sign-unlimited is not send-unlimited: proper unlimited sending starts at Business, $20 per seat on a yearly commitment, while contract-management features gate at Business Pro, $30 per seat.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly ($120/yr), single seat
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-04 on signeasy.com/pricing, including the page's own pricing script) No free plan on the pricing page, a 14-day free trial and a 100-day money-back guarantee. Signeasy's own trial email (24 October 2026) does say an account moves to a Free Plan automatically when the trial ends, without a charge; the pricing page, checked again on 27 October 2026, lists no such plan and does not say what it includes, so treat it as a fallback rather than a plan to choose. Three per-seat eSignature tiers: Personal $15 a month billed monthly or $10 billed yearly ($120), single seat, 5 documents sent for signature a month and no templates; Business $30 or $20 a seat ($240), unlimited sending under a fair-usage note and 5 templates; Business Pro $40 or $30 a seat ($360), with roles, permissions and unlimited templates. The yearly toggle says “Save up to 33%”. The script prices other currencies directly rather than converting: yearly per seat a month that is €8, €14 and €24, £7, £12 and £22, or C$12, C$27 and C$39. A fourth tier, Build Your Plan, is custom-priced for 5+ seats or high volume. New since September is a separate Intelligent Contract Management tab: ICM Core $45 and ICM Pro $60 a month per seat, each with a minimum of 3 seats and a Request Demo button rather than a checkout. Signature APIs sit on their own tab: a free sandbox for 100 requests, Intermediate $125 a month ($1,499 billed annually) for 1,000 and Advanced $250 ($2,999) for 2,000.

free_plan_evidence: Signeasy's own trial email (24 October 2026) does say an account moves to a Free Plan automatically when the trial ends, without a charge; the pricing page, checked again on 27 October 2026, lists no such plan and does not say what it includes, so treat it as a fallback rather than a plan to choose.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 24 October 2026 on the 14-day trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We uploaded two made-up PDF files, downloaded them again and opened the Business checkout without paying.
findings: The trial started without a card; sign-up asked for a phone number. The app showed 'Trial ends in 14 days' with a bar asking us to verify our email address.
Uploading two unsigned test PDFs at once worked; both appeared under Files next to an automatically added sample document.

Downloads stayed blocked until the email address was verified. Selecting files for a bulk download only promised a link by email; single files download from the row menu. The two downloaded PDFs had different bytes from our originals but the same extracted text and page counts (1 and 2 pages).
Purchase Now > Business opened a checkout with yearly billing preselected: EUR 14 per seat per month, EUR 168 billed now for one seat, and no VAT line on that screen. We stopped before paying.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
